subject: rt-int-tr
title: RT.INT.TR.------POL.P.
description: Diagram in WI-19, the section where Braxton introduces the 'grand trade-off'. RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is crossed with POL-P (political policies). Further branches from the main line lead to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → INFO-TRNS (information transference), to INFO-DOC (information documentation), and to DEF (definition). DEF branches to INFO-DE-B (information degree basis) and CN-INFO (controlled information); CN-INFO → AF-COMP (affinity compression) → AGT (agreement).
